 PAK A vs UAE Live streaming details, where & how to watch Match 3, ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026
 By Karan Rawat Follow Add as Preferred Source Karan is a passionate cricket writer with a sharp eye for the game’s nuances. Published at : November 20, 2026 at 10:58 AM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : November 20, 2026 at 10:58 AM (GMT+5:30) PAK A vs UAE Match 3 will be played at University of Doha for Science and Technology, Doha on November 20.
 Match 3 of the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 will see a face-off between Pakistan A and United Arab Emirates. These two sides will take on each other at the University of Doha for Science and Technology, Doha, on Friday at 11:30 AM IST.
 UAE made it to the semifinal of the inaugural edition in 2013. But since then, they have featured in three seasons and failed to go past the group stage. On the other hand, Pakistan are the only side that have featured in the top four of all six editions.
 They are the two-time champions and won the last ODI edition, which took place in 2023. Abdul Samad is leading Pakistan A, and they have put a mix of experienced and young players.
 Mohammad Hasnain, Maaz Sadaqat, Haider Ali, Shamyl Hussain, Hasan Nawaz, Saad Masood, Sufyan Moqim, and Ahmed Daniyal have represented Pakistan A at the international level.

 When to watch the PAK A vs UAE match? Timing details
 Pakistan A will take on UAE in match 3 of the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026, which will take place at the University of Doha for Science and Technology, Doha, on Friday at 11:30 AM IST. The toss of this match will take place at 11 AM IST.
 How to watch the PAK A vs UAE match in India?
 Indian fans can watch the PAK A vs UAE clash in India on the Sony Sports Networks. Fans can access the live stream through the Sony LIV app or website.
 How to watch the PAK A vs UAE match in Pakistan?
 Pakistani fans can catch the live action on the PTV Sports channel on Friday. The live stream of the game will be accessible through the Tamasha or Tapmad streaming platforms.
